subject: general
question: One of the Important Institutes associated with green revolution Is the Indian Agriculture Research Institute. Where is it located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian Agricultural Research Institute is located in New Delhi and was established on **1 April 1905**.
 
• It is also known as Pusa Institute.
 
• It is administered by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR).
 
• After a devastating earthquake on 15th January 1934, the institute was shifted to Delhi on 29th July 1936.
 
• Post-independence, the institute has been renamed as Indian Agricultural Research Institute.
